info.name: SignalAI API
info.description:
Master SignalAI API collection — all endpoints including Upstox, Auth, Charts, Strategies, Backtest, Orders.

Base URL: http://localhost:8003/api/v1
Auth: HTTP Basic (API_USERNAME / API_PASSWORD from .env)

request.description: Returns API name, version, live trading flag, and disclaimer.
Returns { ok, version, uptime_seconds, environment, request_id }.
Root endpoint. Returns API metadata: {name, version, live_trading_enabled, disclaimer}.
Health endpoint. Returns {ok, version, uptime_seconds, environment, request_id}.

Validate credentials. Returns { ok: true, user_id }.
No JWT issued — subsequent requests use HTTP Basic auth.
Returns the currently authenticated user info.
Validate credentials. Returns {ok: true, user_id} on success.
Returns the authenticated user object from Basic auth.
Returns the Upstox OAuth authorization URL. Open in browser to get the auth code.
Exchange OAuth authorization code for access token. Token is stored in Redis and used by all subsequent Upstox endpoints.

Check if an Upstox access token is stored in Redis.
Returns: { connected: true/false }
Removes the Upstox token from Redis.
Returns {url} for Upstox OAuth login.
Exchange Upstox OAuth code and persist token. Returns {ok, client_id}.
Returns {connected: true|false}.
Disconnect broker session. Returns {ok: true}.
Returns {url} for ICICI Direct login.
Connects Breeze session by saving session token.
Checks if Breeze session_id is saved in Redis.
Disconnects Breeze session (deletes session_id from Redis).

Fetch OHLCV candles using a specific ISIN code.

Common ISINs:
- RELIANCE: INE002A01018
- TCS: INE467B01029
- INFY: INE009A01021
- HDFCBANK: INE040A01034
- ICICIBANK: INE090A01021
Fetch OHLCV candles using stock symbol. ISIN is resolved internally from the NIFTY500 instrument map.
Historical candles by exchange + ISIN. Returns {status, candles:[{time, open, high, low, close, volume, oi}]}.
Historical candles by symbol, resolving ISIN internally. Returns {status, candles:[...]}.
Daily historical candles for TCS. Returns {status, candles:[...]}.

item.name: Historical Candle by ISIN (daily, full year 2024)
Historical Candle by Symbol — Unknown symbol → 404

request.description: Fetch options historical data directly from Breeze API.
Fetch options data from Breeze and import/save it to MySQL `candle_data` table.
Fetch today's intraday OHLCV candles for a single symbol. No data is written to the database.
Fetch today's intraday OHLCV candles for multiple symbols in one call. No data is written to the database. Failures for individual symbols are captured per-symbol.
Single-symbol intraday candles. Returns {status, candles:[...]}.
Multi-symbol intraday candles. Returns aggregate status plus per-symbol results[].

Bulk import historical OHLCV data for multiple symbols into the candle_data DB table.

Date ranges are auto-split to respect Upstox limits:
- minutes (1-15): 1 month per chunk
- minutes (>15) / hours: 3 months per chunk
- days/weeks/months: no splitting

interval_value options: 1, 5, 15, 25, 75, 125 (minutes) | 1, 2, 4 (hours) | 1 (days/weeks/months)

Import today's live intraday candles into DB.
Only supports interval_type: minutes | hours.
Bulk import historical candles. Actual API uses stock_codes; symbols is included as a helper alias. Returns import summary with details[].
Bulk import today's intraday candles. Actual API uses stock_codes. Returns import summary with details[].
Returns instrument keys for NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, FINNIFTY, SENSEX.
Returns up to 750 NSE EQ stocks with symbol, name, and sector from the DB.
Look up the ISIN for a given NSE symbol using the live instrument map.
Force-refresh the NSE instrument map by downloading the latest Upstox CSV. Returns { status, symbols_loaded }.
List index instrument mappings. Returns [{symbol, instrument_key}].
List up to 750 NSE equity symbols from DB. Returns [{symbol, name, sector}].
Resolve symbol to ISIN. Returns {symbol, isin, total_symbols}.
Force-refresh instrument map. Returns {status: 'refreshed', symbols_loaded}.
Returns all NSE EQ symbols from the nse_eq_symbols table (symbol, name, sector).
Fetch OHLCV candles. Primary source: stock_data_* DB tables. Falls back to Upstox live API if a connected broker token is available.

Returns latest price, 52-week high/low, average volume from stock_data_daily.
Falls back to Upstox if a broker token is available.

Run a technical-indicator strategy backtest on real DB OHLCV data for multiple symbols.
Returns per-symbol results: trade list, win rate, P&L, max drawdown.
List chart symbols from DB. Returns [{symbol, name, sector}].
Fetch candles from DB with Upstox fallback. Returns {symbol, timeframe, from, to, count, source, candles}.
Fetch latest close and 52-week stats. Returns {symbol, latestClose, latestDate, high52w, low52w, avgVolume, source}.
Indicator backtest. Actual API uses symbols[] + conditions[]; symbol/indicators are included as helper fields. Returns {results, symbolCount}.
Fetch LTP for NIFTY index. Returns {symbol, ltp/source} or {symbol, data, source} depending on broker connectivity.
Fetch LTP by path symbol. Router only recognizes configured index keys; unknown symbols return 404.

Fetch live last traded price for an index.
Supported: NIFTY | BANKNIFTY | FINNIFTY | SENSEX
Requires an active Upstox broker connection.
Fetch OHLCV candles directly from stock_data_<timeframe> for charting. Capped at limit (max 10000).
Return today's ORB signals for the requested symbols. Data is read from the DB — ensure intraday data has been imported first.

Run ORB backtest for a single symbol.

direction: both | long | short
volume_multiplier: 0.5 – 50 (×avg volume for breakout confirmation)
or_candles: 1–10 (number of opening range candles)

Scan current ORB signals and place paper or live orders.

Live trading requires:
- ALLOW_LIVE_TRADING=true in .env
- confirm_live: true in request body
- Active Upstox broker connection
List distinct stock codes available in a stock_data_<timeframe> table.
Return NSE EQ symbols from nse_eq_symbols table. Each item has symbol, company_name, industry.
Fetch chart candles from stock_data_* tables. Returns {symbol, timeframe, candles}.
Fetch today's ORB signals for symbols. Returns an array of signal objects.
ORB backtest. Actual API uses or_candles/timeframe and returns summary with trades[] and signals[].
Scan ORB signals and place paper/live orders. Actual API uses symbols[] and qty. Returns order summary with orders[] and allSignals[].
List distinct symbols available in ORB timeframe table.
Search NSE EQ symbol master. Returns [{symbol, company_name, industry}].
List strategies, optionally filtered by desk. Response is an array of strategy rows.
Create a strategy. Returns created strategy row including id, strategy_json, mode, status, created_at, updated_at.
Fetch one strategy by id. Returns strategy row or 404.
Update mutable strategy fields. Returns {ok: true}.
Duplicate a strategy. Returns copied strategy row with a new id.
Delete a strategy. Returns {ok: true}.

Run a strategy backtest. Supply candles array for custom OHLCV data, or omit to auto-fetch from DB using strategy_json.symbol + candleTime.

Returns: totalTrades, wins, losses, winRate, pnl, maxDrawdown, trades[]
Run a strategy backtest. Actual request uses strategy_json plus optional candles/days; unknown helper fields are ignored. Returns totals and trades[].

header.description: Optional: prevents duplicate orders within 5 minutes

request.description: Place a paper/live order. Actual API requires strategy_id, side, quantity, price, order_type, mode, confirm_live. Returns created order row.
List order records filtered by desk. Response is an array of order rows.

header.description: Optional: prevents duplicate orders within 5 minutes

request.description:
Place a paper or live order.

Live trading requires:
- ALLOW_LIVE_TRADING=true in .env
- confirm_live: true in request body
- Active Upstox broker connection

Supports Idempotency-Key header to prevent duplicate orders within a 5-minute window.
Returns all trades for the current user, ordered by opened_at DESC. Optionally filter by desk.
Returns all orders for the current user, ordered by created_at DESC. Optionally filter by desk.
Returns the last 500 log entries for the current user, ordered by created_at DESC. Optionally filter by desk.
List trades for the authenticated user, optionally filtered by desk.
List order records for the authenticated user, optionally filtered by desk.
List latest logs (max 500), optionally filtered by desk.
